definition: The maximum number of tokens allocated for a given task, request, or component of a system, balancing capability against cost and latency.
details: Managing token budgets is a practical concern in building LLM applications, since both API costs and response latency typically scale with the number of tokens processed and generated.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is Token Budget.
